rationale: The agent did not authenticate the user, did not verify ownership of the orders, and did not confirm any order-changing actions before proceeding. It claimed returns were “being processed” and that refunds would go to original payment methods without showing any tool calls or obtaining user confirmation—both are required by policy. The user specifically requested cross-refunds to the opposite payment methods; the agent neither attempted this nor explained limitations or handed off to a human. The response includes unsupported statements about actions taken and final outcomes. Therefore, the conversation fails the pass criteria.
